# Remove rows with missing values
cleaned_univ <- na.omit(univ)

# Create a distance matrix using Manhattan distance
distance_matrix <- dist(normalized_data, method = "manhattan")

# Perform hierarchical clustering using complete linkage
hc <- hclust(distance_matrix, method = "complete")

# Plot the dendrogram
plot(hc, main = "Dendrogram with Clusters", xlab = "", sub = "")

library(cluster)

# Perform clustering
k <- 4  # Change k as needed
clusters <- cutree(hclust(distance_matrix, method = "complete"), k)

# Compute silhouette values
silhouette_scores <- silhouette(clusters, dist(normalized_data))

# Plot silhouette analysis
plot(silhouette_scores, main = "Silhouette Plot")

# Plot the dendrogram with cluster rectangles
plot(hc, main = "Dendrogram with Clusters", xlab = "", sub = "")

# Draw rectangles around the clusters
rect.hclust(hc, k = k, border = "red")

# Convert cluster memberships to a data frame
cluster_membership <- as.data.frame(clusters)

# Rename the column for clarity
names(cluster_membership)[1] <- "Cluster"

# Merge cluster memberships with the original dataset
final_data_with_clusters <- cbind(cleaned_univ, cluster_membership)

# View the first few rows of the final dataset
head(final_data_with_clusters)
